_comment: Segment header for the factories-tokenomics-dataset schema (§4.3 of the guide — EPAM's cross-factory AI cost/tokenomics dataset). Copy this file to reports/tokenomics/factory-profile.json in your project and fill in the placeholders below (anything wrapped in <angle brackets>). Filled once, hand-authored — not regenerated by build-tokenomics-report.mjs. Review before every export batch, especially efficiency_techniques and pipeline as your setup evolves. The non-placeholder defaults below (stop/owner_group/work_item_level/scope/currency/efficiency_techniques/pipeline) hold for any stock manual-qa bundle install — only override them if your fork of the bundle actually differs (e.g. parallel test-runner dispatch instead of sequential, a different agent roster).
factory_name: <Your Project / App Under Test> — Manual QA (AI-driven Playwright MCP execution)
efficiency_techniques: other:sequential-tc-isolation (one test-runner dispatched at a time, per test-run-lead RULES.md, to keep failures attributable)
